features.title: Divine spellcaster
features.text: Your deity grants divine magic and additional spell choices. Doctrine shapes your approach: focused casting as a cloistered cleric or armored combat as a warpriest.

features.title: Divine font
features.text: Extra slots for heal or harm support your chosen role. Preparation can emphasize healing, protection or offensive magic; not every cleric plays as a healer.
